answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 162589 Country: India Title: What should be read in the second Rakah of Taraweeh while sitting? Question: While offering Taravih behind an Imam, what should be read in the second rakah while sitting? Is it the same as a normal salah or is their a shorter method. I am asking this because generally I am not able to complete reading attahiyat, Durood and other duas which I am able to do otherwise in fardh salah. Answer ID: 162589 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1216/995/SD=9/1439) One should read the same Tashahhud in taravih which is read in salah. No separate Tashahhud is reported for the same. It is very much possible that Imam Sahib reads Tashahhud etc in taravih quickly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
